lines.beaver_en: How was today's final? It was really close, right?
lines.en: Yes, it was close to the end, so the cheering was huge.

lines.beaver_en: How would you rate our starting players?
lines.learner: 김민수 선수는 득점하는 등 공격에 재능을 발휘했어요.
lines.en: Kim Minsu showed talent in attack, such as scoring.
lines.roman: Gim Minsu seonsuneun deukjeomhaneun deung gonggyeoge jaeneungeul balhwihaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The way they attacked the opponent's goal was good too, right?
lines.en: Yes, their shooting was accurate, so the attack was sharp.

lines.beaver_en: But wasn't the defense a little disappointing?
lines.learner: 맞아요. 후반에 방어가 약해서 반칙도 많았어요.
lines.en: Right. The defense was weak in the second half, with many fouls.
lines.roman: majayo. hubane bangeoga yakaeseo banchikdo manasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: We can say they broke the final-match jinx this time, right?
lines.learner: 네, 강팀과 맞붙어서 이겼으니 깼다고 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, they faced a strong team and won, so I think so.
lines.roman: ne, gangtimgwa matbuteoseo igyeosseuni kkaetdago bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: How did the athletes in other events do?
lines.en: In the track sprint, they won a silver medal.

lines.beaver_en: What about boxing? Expectations were high there too.
lines.en: Boxing went from win to win, and everyone placed.

lines.beaver_en: How do you see the next tournament?
lines.learner: 강한 나라들과 겨루니까 변수가 많을 거예요.
lines.en: They'll compete with strong countries, so there'll be many variables.
lines.roman: ganhan naradeulgwa gyeorunikka byeonsuga maneul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then what should they prepare more?
lines.en: They mustn't overlook defense, starting from the qualifiers.

lines.beaver: 좋은 분석 감사해요. 오늘 방송 마칠까요?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the great analysis. Shall we wrap up today's broadcast?
lines.beaver_roman: joeun bunseok gamsahaeyo. oneul bangsong machilkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 응원해 주신 시청자 여러분 감사합니다!
lines.en: Yes, thank you to all the viewers who cheered!
lines.roman: ne, eungwonhae jusin sicheongja yeoreobun gamsahamnida!
